Commentary.Commentary: Goodbye! That draws the curtains on a dominant display from Pakistan U19, who sealed a comprehensive victory. The cricketing action rolls on without a pause, so mark your calendars for Wednesday, January 28th, when Australia U19 lock horns with West Indies U19 at 7.30 am GMT. Be sure to join us for the pre-match build-up as we prepare for another thrilling contest. Until then, take care and goodbye!
Abdul Subhan is the Player of the Match for his exceptional unbeaten knock of 76 runs.

Subhan and Raza dismantled the Kiwis! Earlier in the game, Pakistan U-19 delivered a ruthless bowling masterclass in Harare, bundling New Zealand U-19 out for a paltry 110 in just 28.3 overs. Despite a blazing start fueled by Hugo Bogue that saw the Kiwis race to 50 in 6.6 overs, the innings imploded spectacularly once the partnership between Bogue and skipper Tom Jones was broken. The middle order collapsed under pressure, sliding from 67/4 to 67/7 in a flash, driven by Abdul Subhan’s poetic spell of 4/11 and Ali Raza’s aggressive 3/36.

Kiwis had no answers with the ball - Defending such a low total, the New Zealand bowlers had almost no margin for error. Mason Clarke and Luke Harrison managed to pick up a wicket each, but they simply didn't have enough runs on the board to apply any real pressure. It was a one-sided affair in the end, as Pakistan cruised to a comfortable win with plenty of wickets in hand.

Sameer Minhas blasts Pakistan to victory! A dominant win for Pakistan Under-19! They wasted no time chasing down the small target of 111. Although they lost Hamza Zahoor early, Sameer Minhas took complete charge of the innings, smashing the bowlers to all parts of the ground. Usman Khan played a supporting role with a steady 15 before getting out, but Minhas remained unstoppable, scoring a blistering unbeaten 76 to guide his team home in just 18 overs.
